title: Find a Pattern · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Find a Pattern · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a visible repeated pattern in the room. The lead describes the repeating elements without naming the object. The group locates the object and confirms the pattern. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Find a Pattern, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group locates the object and confirms the pattern.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group locates the object and confirms the pattern.
